name: Telegram Samsung Backup Bot app for macOS

plan.techStack: Swift 5.9, SwiftUI, SwiftData, FSEvents, CryptoKit, MTProto Swift, macOS 14+
steps: Configure macOS app project with SwiftUI lifecycle, App Sandbox entitlements, and user-selected file read/write permissions
Implement SecureBookmark utility to persist folder access permissions across app restarts using bookmark data
Define SwiftData schema entities for SyncFolder, FileRecord, and TopicMapping with proper relationships and indexing
Build FileMonitor service using FSEvents to detect live filesystem changes in monitored directories
Develop Chunker service with CryptoKit AES-256 encryption and per-file SHA-256 hashing for 700MB zip archives
Implement MTProtoClient service for User API authentication, session persistence, and chunked upload support
Create SyncEngine orchestrator to debounce FSEvents, manage upload queues, and handle resume logic via SwiftData
Build topic management system to flatten folder paths into Telegram forum topic names with hash-based collision avoidance
Develop SwiftUI interface with folder list display, per-folder progress indicators, and dry-run toggle
Add comprehensive error handling with exponential backoff for Telegram FloodWait and network resilience
plan.architectNotes: Native macOS Swift app; leverages MTProto User API for 700MB uploads, SwiftData for atomic state management, FSEvents for continuous monitoring, and SecureBookmarks for persistent folder access across restarts
plan.reviewerNotes: Clarify scope as unidirectional backup vs bidirectional sync; implement truncated hashed topic names to avoid Telegram 128-character limit; MTProto phone authentication adds deployment complexity versus simple Bot API tokens
